captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a customizable cartoon minion figure standing on a circular bevelled base. The character features a cylindrical body with a hemispherical dome head, dual-goggle eyes with a strap wrap-around, and thin arms holding stylized missile or rocket props in each hand. The bottom portion of the body is styled with overalls, complete with shoulder straps, and rests on two small legs connected to the base plate.
captions.instruction: Create a highly customizable and parametric minion character model in OpenSCAD. The script should allow adjustments for body dimensions, number of eyes (goggles), mouth expression, arm angles, and different hand-held props like rockets or bombs, with an option to select which parts of the model to render (e.g., full body, front half, back half, or base).
captions.factory: The design is constructed using basic geometric primitives. The main body combines a cylinder with a custom hemisphere module (difference of sphere and cylinder). The arms are built using a series of cylinders and spheres for joints, with a custom hand module containing extruded fingers. The overalls are constructed using a cylinder with subtracted cubes for the armholes and scaled cylinders for the shoulder straps, while the entire assembly is positioned on a circular base plate.
